QuestInfo.name: Golem Attack
QuestInfo.0: Roca, the informant in Henesys, needs your help!
QuestInfo.1: You received a request from Roca, an informant in Henesys, to defend Golem's Temple from the Mixed Golems. Defeat 50 Mixed Golems.
QuestInfo.2: You found the mutant Mixed Golems and defeated them, but Irena already came and went. Irena took all the credit again!

0.0: Hello there! I believe this is the first time we've met, isn't it? I don't know, I've been told I have the memory of a goldfish. The name's Roca and I'm a scout from Ereve. I called you because the golems are going crazy over at the Golem's Temple south of Henesys.

no.0: Are you sure? Wait, who are you?

0.1: I need somebody to go clear out the Mixed Golems before they tear the place down! I'll send you straight over when you accept. Defeat any Mixed Golem you see, because it's hard to tell which ones are theones causing trouble.

1.0: Ah, Mihile. Did you go to the Golem's Temple?\r\n#L0##bYes, but I couldn't find any mutated Mixed Golems.#l\n#k
1.1: What? I don't remember that. I sent a lady named Arena or Iringo or something to take care of the golems. Were you out there too? That's kind of mean, just beating up on innocent golems. You're mean!

yes.0: Why do you look so angry? \r\n#bBecause there's a woman who keeps beating me to my own work and I think it's my own fault...#k

mob.0: Oh, by the way, some of the golems are mutants, but they look the same as the regular Mixed Golems. You're going to have to smash about 50 just to be sure you got the bad ones.
